@source:    mentalism_companion
@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Dream Lore
@category:  Training Package
#
# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.
#
 1 | Awaken Self | caster | - | self | Us
 2 | Dream I | caster | sleep | self | I
 3 | Sleep Control | caster | sleep | self | U
 4 | Store Own Dream Pattern | caster | P | self | Ps
 5 | Dream Communication I | 1 target | C | 100’/lvl | Fms
 6 | Dream II | caster | sleep | self | I
 7 | Enter Dreams I | varies | C | 100’/lvl | Fms
 8 | Lucid Dream I | caster | sleep | self | I
 9 | Dream Sentry | caster | sleep | self | F
10 | Dream III | caster | sleep | self | I
11 | Dream Healing II | caster | sleep | self | U
12 | Dream Communication II | 1 target | C | 1000’/lvl | Fms
13 | Dream Cloak | caster | sleep | self | E
14 | Enter Dreams II | varies | C | 1000’/lvl | Fms
15 | Lord Dreams | caster | sleep | self | I
16 | Lucid Dream II | caster | sleep | self | I
18 | Dream Communication III | 1 target | C | 1 mi/lvl | Fms
19 | Dream Healing III | caster | sleep | self | U
20 | Enter Dreams III | varies | C | 1 mi/lvl | Fms
25 | Lucid Dreams III | caster | sleep | self | I
30 | Dream Communication True | 1 target | C | 10 mi/lvl | Fms
50 | Enter Dreams True | varies | C | 10 mi/lvl | Fms

# Descriptions
@@ 1
This subconsciously activated spell will awaken the caster from any form of
sleep (magical or nonmagical). The caster will require only one round to come
fully awake. This spell works by assimilating sensory cues from the caster’s
surroundings and allowing the caster’s subconscious to determine if the caster
should awaken in response.
@@ 2
Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The
caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 3 hours) for this spell
to work.
@@ 3
By casting this spell prior to retiring, the caster can fully control his next
sleep cycle, allowing him to fall asleep at his own pace (instantly or
gradually; even in noisy or otherwise disruptive environments) and to set the
duration of the sleep cycle.
@@ 4
The caster may store the parameters of one of his own dreams for use with
spells later on this list and on the Dream Law spell list. The caster can only
store as many sleeping dream patterns equal to his Memory stat (not stat
bonus). The caster may release a dream pattern at any time. The caster’s
player is responsible for noting which dream patterns are stored.
@@ 5
The caster can communicate via dream-speech with a single target chosen by the
caster prior to retiring. The caster must have previously stored the target’s
Dreamer Pattern. In addition the target must be asleep, must be able to dream
(i.e., is not under an Undream or equivalent spell), and the target’s pattern
must not be concealed (i.e., is not under the effects of a Dream Cloak, Dream
Masquerade, Dream Invisibility, or equivalent spell). The target must be no
further than 100’ per level (of the caster) distant. The communication is
two-way although recipients who are not Mentalism spell users will (at GM’s
discretion) “talk in their sleep” while conversing.
@@ 6
As Dream I, except the limit is 2 dreams per sleep cycle on different topics.
@@ 7
The caster can enter the sleeping dreams or nightmares of one or more targets
chosen at time of casting prior to retiring. The caster must have previously
stored each target’s Dreamer Pattern. In addition, each target must be asleep,
must be able to dream (i.e., is not under an Undream or equivalent spell), and
each target’s pattern must not be concealed (i.e., is not under the effects of
a Dream Cloak, Dream Masquerade, Dream Invisibility, or equivalent spell). The
target(s) must be no further than 100’ per level of the caster away. The
caster may only enter the dreams or nightmares of more than one target if all
the desired targets are experiencing the same dream or nightmare. Upon entry
to a target’s dreams, the caster may choose merely to passively observe or to
interact with the dream and/or dreamer.
@@ 8
As Dream I, except the caster has a “lucid” dream which will initially relate
to a topic decided upon just before retiring. Alternatively the caster may
choose to repeat a stored Dream pattern.
@@ 9
By casting this spell just before retiring, the caster assigns a portion of
his subconscious mind to monitor any attempts by others to detect, store,
observe or manipulate the caster dream-self pattern or his dreams for the
duration of his sleep cycle. Such spells must make an RR versus the caster’s
level. If the RR succeeds, the attempt may proceed normally. If the RR fails,
the caster’s subconscious is alerted to the nature of the incoming spell and
the attempt fails.
@@ 10
As Dream I, except the limit is 3 dreams per sleep cycle on different topics.
@@ 11
By casting this spell just before retiring, the caster increases the rate at
which his body heals during the sleep cycle, regaining twice as many
concussion hits as normal. Additionally other injuries heal at twice normal
rate during the healing sleep.
@@ 12
As Dream Communication I, except for the range.
@@ 13
By casting this spell before retiring, the caster can conceal his dream-self
pattern and any dreams he may experience for the duration of his sleep cycle.
This observing or storing his dreams and will cause Dream Communication, Enter
Dream, Locate Dreamer, and other spells which require a detectable dream-self
pattern to fail.
@@ 14
As Enter Dreams I, except for the range.
@@ 15
As Dream I, except the limit is 5 dreams per sleep cycle on any combination of
topics chosen by the caster.
@@ 16
As Lucid Dream I, except the limit is 2 “lucid” dreams per sleep cycle on
different topics.
@@ 18
As Dream Communication I, except for the range.
@@ 19
As Dream Healing II, except the caster recovers three times normal concussion
hits and other injuries heal at three times normal rate.
@@ 20
As Enter Dreams I, except for the range.
@@ 25
As Lucid Dream I, except the limit is 3 “lucid” dreams per sleep cycle on
different topics.
@@ 30
As Dream Communication I, except for the range.
@@ 50
As Enter Dreams I, except for the range.
